description: Writes the signed-in user’s own preferences and nobody else’s. Only the fields you name change: leave one out and it is untouched, pass null and it is cleared, which puts that question back to the company and then to the country pack. It changes nothing in the books.

date_display_format.description: How this person likes a date written.

language.description: Two letters, optionally a region. Labels are read in it first.

number_display_format.description: How this person likes a number written. Not the pattern a document number is built from, which belongs to the country.

name: set_preferences
title: Change what this user prefers
